name: chunked strict: != 改成 >
old:
if len(chunk) != n:
                    raise ValueError('iterable is not divisible by n.')
new:
if len(chunk) > n:
                    raise ValueError('iterable is not divisible by n.')

name: chunked: n<0 改成 n<1（多拒了 0）
old:
if n is not None and n < 0:
        raise ValueError('n must be at least 0')
new:
if n is not None and n < 1:
        raise ValueError('n must be at least 0')

name: windowed: n<=0 改成 n<0（少拒了 0）
old:
if n <= 0:
        raise ValueError('n must be > 0')
new:
if n < 0:
        raise ValueError('n must be > 0')

name: windowed: step<1 改成 step<0（少拒了 0）
old:
if step < 1:
        raise ValueError('step must be >= 1')
new:
if step < 0:
        raise ValueError('step must be >= 1')

name: windowed: 尾部 padding 的 step-1 改成 step
old: padding = (fillvalue,) * (n - 1 if step >= n else step - 1)
new: padding = (fillvalue,) * (n - 1 if step >= n else step)

name: windowed: 首窗不满的判定 < n 改成 <= n
old:
if len(window) < n:
        yield tuple(window) + ((fillvalue,) * (n - len(window)))
new:
if len(window) <= n:
        yield tuple(window) + ((fillvalue,) * (n - len(window)))

name: windowed: 首窗不满时补的填充数 n-len 改成 n-len+1
